tips: No single fault stands out: 7 m (0.8 lengths) went before the mark and 21 m (2.2 lengths) after. Same routine, a little smoother, to close the gap to your best.
Came out at 41° to the wind, low and wide (your best exited at 17°). Finish the turn close to close-hauled; the wide entry is what makes a tight exit possible.
